# Class `puc::timer::Scheduler`

Schedule chrono-duration timeouts on one running JobQueue generation.

[Scheduler](#) borrows the queue and does not own its threads. Its lifecycle owner must destroy or stop all dependents before the borrowed queue is stopped.

[Source](../../utils/timer/scheduler.hpp#L66)
